free_design.Place: an open-air riverside swimming club at dawn, a small lane pool alongside the river, a floating cork marker at her feet
free_design.Activity: after racing her own drifting cork marker, she pauses on the dry pool edge and lifts one side of the short warm-up overskirt to drain trapped pool water; the secure swimsuit stays completely in place
free_design.Pose: standing facing three-quarters toward the viewer; right arm bends forward to lift the outer skirt edge with her right hand; left arm hangs naturally with her left hand open at her side; both arms connect visibly to their own shoulders
free_design.Framing: a full-body vertical shot from chest-height camera, both hands and feet visible, her face angled toward the viewer with a small relaxed smile
free_design.Outfit: an opaque burnt-orange asymmetrical swim romper: a plunge halter swimsuit joined to a tiny wrap overskirt with a single sculpted folded corner; open back and high leg cuts, secure lining covers intimate areas, one edge of the outer wrap lifted only to drain water
